summary: No unresolved correctness, safety, replay, UTF-8, budget-admission, timing-boundary, repair, immutability, or offline-authorization defect was found in the approved fixed-game offline harness. All prior reported findings are closed in the frozen source and recorded evidence. Approval is limited to offline synthetic engineering verification; it is not scientific efficacy, noninferiority, live-model readiness, or launch approval.

prior_finding_closure.title: Failed posthoc replay credited as overall engineering success
prior_finding_closure.prior_reproduction: Reach the task goal, then return a failed or mismatched posthoc replay.
prior_finding_closure.current_behavior: The timely observed goal remains primary_success=true, while semantic_replay.valid=false makes engineering_status non-PASS and accepted_for_engineering_verification=false. The CLI requires both primary success and engineering acceptance for exit 0; bookkeeping exposes primary and verified-primary counts separately.
prior_finding_closure.test_defense: test_replay_failure_preserves_primary_goal_but_rejects_engineering_credit is present in the recorded zero-failure suite.

prior_finding_closure.title: Unsafe goal-reaching trace was discarded instead of separating outcome and safety
prior_finding_closure.prior_reproduction: Return a completed Godot trace that reaches the goal but reports a committed invariant violation.
prior_finding_closure.current_behavior: Godot commit retains the final snapshot and counts committed transitions before classifying a failed engine gate as safety FAIL/NOT_PASS. run_episode observes and preserves a reached goal independently, then engineering acceptance fails on safety.
prior_finding_closure.test_defense: test_completed_unsafe_goal_retains_witness_and_fails_safety_without_more_dispatch proves primary_success=true, safety FAIL, no engineering acceptance, and no further dispatch.

prior_finding_closure.title: Non-JSON proposal evidence could erase an assigned row
prior_finding_closure.prior_reproduction: Return a proposal containing an object, set, NaN, or lone surrogate, or return such content from the prompt callback.
prior_finding_closure.current_behavior: Canonical JSON is validated as strict UTF-8 bytes before evidence retention or admission. Invalid values become bounded JSON-safe diagnostics; final hashing and exclusive output persistence therefore retain the assigned failure row.
prior_finding_closure.test_defense: The recorded suite includes proposal object/set/NaN/surrogate cases, non-JSON P-adapter output, and strict UTF-8 persisted-row/hash assertions.

prior_finding_closure.title: Setup and engine execution were charged to the wrong timing boundaries
prior_finding_closure.prior_reproduction: Spend substantial time in fixed-project setup before first dispatch, or let an engine action take longer than the 60-second provider response deadline while remaining inside the 180-second episode wall.
prior_finding_closure.current_behavior: The episode wall starts immediately before first host dispatch; setup remains preparation. Native provider timeout is min(response deadline, remaining wall), while non-replay engine execution receives remaining episode wall. Posthoc replay is explicitly outside goal-completion wall accounting.
prior_finding_closure.test_defense: Recorded tests separately cover setup exclusion, response-late rejection without commit, charged host/planning/validation/repair/engine time, and an engine action exceeding 60 seconds but completing inside the episode wall.

prior_finding_closure.title: Offline CLI omitted the corrective re-proposal path
prior_finding_closure.prior_reproduction: Return a malformed first typed adapter response and a valid corrected response within the two-repair budget.
prior_finding_closure.current_behavior: The CLI passes engine.repair. The adapter appends the authoritative validator error and attempt to the representation context, reuses the logical decision lineage, and the loop bounds attempts by max_repairs_per_decision while charging each observed host call.
prior_finding_closure.test_defense: The real P interpreter/controller seam is exercised with malformed-first/valid-second output, shared logical_request_id, VALIDATOR_ERROR lineage, one charged repair, and goal completion; CLI composition independently proves repair wiring.

prior_finding_closure.title: Replay goal-witness equality accepted missing evidence
prior_finding_closure.prior_reproduction: Omit the top-level goal field in original and replay traces so None==None could pass, or conflict the top-level and final observation witnesses.
prior_finding_closure.current_behavior: The replay comparator extracts an actual final boolean witness, requires original and replay witnesses to be non-null and equal, requires action/top-level consistency when present, and combines this with fresh-process comparison and replay gate success.
prior_finding_closure.test_defense: Recorded tests reject a changed final goal when top-level evidence is absent and reject conflicting top-level versus final witnesses.

prior_finding_closure.title: Shared callback JSON ingress could still drop assigned records
prior_finding_closure.prior_reproduction: Return wrong-type or non-JSON state, context, validation, commit, goal, replay, final-state, or extension evidence.
prior_finding_closure.current_behavior: checked() enforces expected type plus canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes before dereference/storage. Callback failures become assigned failure records; malformed post-terminal evidence preserves primary outcome but rejects engineering acceptance.
prior_finding_closure.test_defense: The recorded test matrix covers malformed initial/semantic state, validation, commit, goal, replay, and final-state paths with immutable output rows.

prior_finding_closure.title: Lone UTF-16 surrogate and surrogate-bearing exception messages could evade JSON checks and fail UTF-8 hashing
prior_finding_closure.prior_reproduction: Return U+D800 in proposal/state/validation/commit/goal/replay/P-adapter evidence, or raise an exception whose message contains U+D800.
prior_finding_closure.current_behavior: All canonical validation now goes through _json_bytes, so UnicodeEncodeError is caught as ValueError. _safe_text uses UTF-8 backslash replacement and _error_text applies it to exception diagnostics. Invalid callback content never reaches record hashing as an unencodable scalar.
prior_finding_closure.test_defense: Recorded tests include lone-surrogate proposal, callback families, a surrogate-bearing proposal exception message, and P-interpreter surrogate detail; each asserts strict UTF-8 persistence and stable record hash.

prior_finding_closure.title: Post-dispatch observable host-call delta could exceed the frozen cap and still commit
prior_finding_closure.prior_reproduction: Set max_host_calls=1; let one proposal source perform two observable prompt callbacks and return a valid goal-completing proposal.
prior_finding_closure.current_behavior: The finally block replaces the provisional one-call charge with the observed prompt-invocation delta. A post-dispatch greater-than-cap admission gate discards the proposal before validation and commit. The comparison is strictly greater-than, so an invocation that lands exactly on the final allowed call remains eligible, preserving terminal budget precedence.
prior_finding_closure.test_defense: test_observed_prompt_invocation_delta_is_charged_before_commit covers both over-budget rejection with zero commits and exact-final-call success.

additional_contract_check.question: Does a JSON-object validation callback admit an action only when valid is literal true?
additional_contract_check.answer: Yes. The callback result must first be a JSON dictionary. validate.valid must then be an actual bool. Missing, the string 'false', integer 1, or list [] raises validation_failure before commit. Literal False satisfies the type contract but is not admitted and follows bounded repair/exhaustion. Only `validation.get("valid") is True` assigns the proposal to accepted.
additional_contract_check.trusted_boundary_note: GodotEpisodeEngine.validate returns real Python booleans. The generic run_episode callback contract still independently enforces bool type and literal-True admission; no malicious configuration premise is required.

assigned_row_json_utf8_safety.notes: Strict canonical UTF-8 byte validation covers values and exception diagnostics before record hashing/persistence. Output files use exclusive creation.

post_dispatch_observed_call_budget.notes: Observed delta is charged before validation/commit; greater-than-cap proposals are discarded; exactly the last allowed call remains admissible.

wall_response_setup_boundaries.notes: Setup precedes the episode clock; provider response deadline and remaining episode wall are distinct; validation, repair, planning, and engine time are charged after dispatch; posthoc replay is separately labeled.

bounded_repair.notes: Repair is wired in CLI and adapter, retains logical lineage and authoritative error context, is bounded per decision, and is charged to wall/call accounting.

independent_goal_witness.notes: Primary credit comes from engine.objective_reached after commit and within wall, never model self-report. Replay additionally requires a final boolean witness.

separate_primary_safety_replay_verdicts.notes: Primary goal, mandatory safety, semantic replay, engineering status, and engineering acceptance remain distinct; unsafe or replay-invalid goals are retained but not engineering-accepted.

immutable_native_inputs_and_frozen_sourc.notes: Episode and replay inputs use exclusive creation; native receipts preserve before/after input hashes; final integrity reports 46 protected files unchanged and records exact hashes for all four reviewed source/test files. Both source-bound smoke records contain the final runtime and CLI hashes.

denied_live_mode.notes: CLI rejects missing --offline or any --live before staging/import. run_episode independently rejects non-offline model/provider/launcher configuration before engine/source activity.

trusted_fixed_adapter_configuration.notes: No finding was promoted from malicious configure/property behavior. Review conclusions use the approved fixed Godot adapter and the explicit generic callback contract only.

recorded_evidence_summary.provenance: reviewed recorded artifacts; not reexecuted by this reviewer

standards_notes: No hardcoded credential, provider call, live-mode escape, source-project execution, unsafe overwrite, or scientific-claim promotion was found in scope.
No style-only finding was manufactured. The large runtime module was assessed by concrete reachable behavior rather than file length alone.
The fixed-adapter configure/property boundary was treated as trusted per the assignment; generic callback outputs that cross the public run_episode seam remain explicitly type/UTF-8 checked.
spec_notes: The implementation matches the approved offline-only Seed and approval defaults: 180-second wall, 60-second provider response deadline, 12 observable host calls, two logical repairs per decision, serial execution, fixed staged Godot game, representation-only input swap, independent goal observation, separate safety gate, and assigned-denominator bookkeeping.

The endpoint amendment's primary goal numerator remains separate from mandatory safety. Missing verification is never success; unsafe goal-reaching episodes remain visible; replay is engineering evidence rather than a new sample.

Unknown provider identity/revision/request count/cost remain null. Offline fixtures and smokes are labeled synthetic engineering evidence and are not promoted to model efficacy or C noninferiority observations.
scope_limits: Approval applies only to the four requested source/test files against the four frozen contract artifacts and the named final evidence/prior-review artifacts.
No Git or shell commands, formatters, linters, test runners, native processes, provider calls, network calls, installations, protocol changes, or game changes were performed.
Recorded test and smoke results were inspected but not independently reexecuted; commands_run=false and tests_run=false are literal reviewer statements.

The review does not approve scientific efficacy, model superiority, noninferiority, statistical design, provider identity/access parity, cost bounds, live model readiness, research episode launch, deployment, or any source-bound activation.

Historical FIX receipts are treated as prior findings and closure inputs, not current verdicts. The immutable approval/Seed and protected-byte/source-hash receipt are the baseline, not repository HEAD.

self_evaluation.summary: The final review is source-anchored, spec-separated, and explicit about recorded versus independently executed evidence.

accuracy.evidence: Every closure is tied to current source/test anchors and frozen artifacts; the only limitation is mandated non-execution, so runtime evidence is recorded rather than independently reproduced.

completeness.evidence: All requested files, four contract artifacts, four prior findings artifacts, Unicode and observable-delta closures, final integrity, focused test receipt, paired smokes, and the parent-requested validation-marker boundary are covered.

clarity.evidence: The JSON separates current findings, prior closures, acceptance checks, recorded evidence, standards/spec notes, and scope limits.

actionability.evidence: The verdict is unambiguous, there are zero unresolved findings, and each prior defect has exact current anchors and its defending regression evidence.

conciseness.evidence: The closure matrix is necessarily detailed and repeats some anchors across acceptance checks, but that repetition preserves machine-readable traceability requested by the assignment.

self_evaluation.improvement: Under a future execution-authorized review, independently recomputing the four source hashes and replaying the focused suite/smokes would raise evidence independence; this review correctly did not do so.
